core_tests.command: taskset -c 4-15 cargo nextest run -p spenso -p idenso --features spenso/shadowing --cargo-profile dev-optim -P local_test --test-threads 8 --retries 0 --no-fail-fast --offline

hep_tests.command: cargo nextest run -p spenso-hep-lib --test metric_contraction_validation --test short_trace_validation --cargo-profile dev-optim --test-threads 4 --retries 0 --offline
hep_tests.oracle: Exact Atom-valued HEP tensor component contractions before and after rewriting. No requirement of a common symbolic normal form.

passed_commands: cargo clippy -p spenso -p idenso --features spenso/shadowing --lib --tests --examples --profile dev-optim --offline -- -D warnings
cargo clippy -p spenso-hep-lib --test metric_contraction_validation --test short_trace_validation --profile dev-optim --offline -- -D warnings

broader_target_failure.cause: Unchanged crates/spenso-hep-lib/src/lib.rs:886 calls hep_lib_atom::<AbstractIndex, i32>(), but i32 does not implement the tensor traits required by that factory.
broader_target_failure.baseline_evidence: Same call exists at revision c2942ab8, before this implementation.

validation.format: Rustfmt checks passed for changed Rust sources; notebook AST parsing and uvx --offline ruff format --check passed.

methodology.rounds: One serial before run then one after run, each with five rotating-method batches per case; medians of five samples.
methodology.public_pipeline: Calls the linked Idenso library. Final after executable is built by Cargo; before uses preserved baseline libraries and Cargo-equivalent frontend options.
methodology.isolated_core: Source-included contractor. Before is an extracted copy of the prior 3 direct + 3 chain + 6 trace tuple rules and fixed-point dispatch. This isolates the contractor and excludes dot/bracket normalization and rank1-vector rules.
methodology.guarded_core: Same raw core preceded by has_repeated_explicit_indices in both variants. The repeated guard is also measured alone; no guard is used in metric_contractor_only.
methodology.correctness: Output snapshots are checked byte-for-byte, including public pipeline outputs. Term counts describe representation only. Independent exact HEP component validation is reported separately by the integration test suite.
methodology.form: FORM 5.0.0 trace4 benchmark runs after Rust measurements. Wall and internal CPU estimates have different scopes; see FORM metadata. Neither term counts nor timings establish parity.

final_build.production_symbol_check: New Idenso MetricContraction symbols present; all legacy METRIC_FUNCTION_CONTRACTIONS symbols absent.

form.method: One warmup process then three samples of six batches. CPU times cover trace4 plus .sort, excluding input creation. Wall includes process startup, parsing, tracing, sorting, count reporting, drop and shutdown, amortized per trace. Correctness is not inferred from matching term counts.
